name: Cosine Projection via Upsampling
aliases: Cosine Projection via Upsampling — Get Cos Projection
Get Cos Projection, Generate Views, Get Cos Projection
definition: Applies cosine projection based on the viewing zenith angle (VZA) by upsampling, scaling, padding, and interpolating.
summary: Cosine Projection via Upsampling generates multi-angle view projections by upsampling data and applying a cosine scaling factor to grid spacing, explicitly accounting for angular dependency rather than merely preventing boundary artifacts.
